analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue for Q2 FY27, driven by strong performance in the process and insulating oil segment and elevated gross margin spreads. Management highlighted ongoing operational and supply chain challenges stemming from geopolitical tensions in West Asia and the Strait of Hormuz, affecting the UAE subsidiary Texol and export volumes. Despite these headwinds, domestic volumes grew and the company maintained profitability supported by disciplined sourcing and value-added product focus. The company's installed capacity on a consolidated basis stands at 838,637 kiloliters, and it remains net cash positive. Management reported a strong performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, highlighted by the highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹1,847 crore and a significant increase in profitability driven by sourcing agility and disciplined inventory management.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of margins remaining at or around current levels for the whole year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11% during the year.
guidance.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates export revenue and export sales will be at the same level for the quarters to come.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates the trend in the PHPO and process and insulating oil segments to continue to be similar for the next quarters.
guidance.quote: So, these are the two segments where we anticipate the growth will be similar. The trend will continue to be similar for the next quarters as well.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates the margins would continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.
guidance.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

guidance.claim: Management expects transformer oil or the PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.
guidance.quote: we anticipate even our transformer oil that is the PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from the health care and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.
demand_outlook.quote: However, demand from the health care and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the process and insulating oil segment was driven by healthy demand from transformers, power, and the rubber industry.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was driven by healthy demand from the transformers, power and the rubber industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The company sees encouraging long-term growth opportunities for the process and insulating oil segment due to increasing electricity demand and power infrastructure investments.
demand_outlook.quote: With increasing electricity demand and continued investment in the power infrastructure in India and globally, we see encouraging long-term growth opportunity for this segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand environment remains encouraging despite global macroeconomic and geopolitical developments.
demand_outlook.quote: While we remain watchful of global macroeconomic and geopolitical developments, the underlying demand environment remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a continuous gap between the demand and supply of base oil due to refinery closures and vessel disruptions.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, there is a supply gap because of refinery closures because of vessel disruption. So, there continues to be a gap between the demand and the supply.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced strong traction in process and insulating oils (PIO) driven by demand from the transformer, power, and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business delivered robust performance growing 28% year-on-year supported by healthy demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The lubricant business remained broadly stable, providing a resilient revenue base.
demand_outlook.quote: While the lubricant business remained broadly stable, it continued to provide a resilient revenue base and reinforce strength of our diversified portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared to 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: PIE manufacturing volumes went up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.
demand_outlook.quote: But on a consolidated basis, Vinit, the PIO manufacturing volumes have gone up from 14,000 to 18,000 KL.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Our installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital Work in Progress has been capitalized over the last 1.5 to 2 years, enhancing capacity at Indian plants.
capex_expansion.quote: So, see, we've been capitalizing our CWIP over the last 1.5-2 years which has been enhancing capacity at both the Indian plants.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity for Indian plants stands at 602,713 kiloliters while Texol installed capacity remains unchanged at 235,924 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Having enumerated the same, our installed capacity for the Indian plants now stood at 602,713. As the installed capacity remains unchanged of Texol of 2,35,924, the total installed capacity now stands at 838,000

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter to strengthen operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for the quarter stood at 21% with a gross margin spread of approximately INR29,128 per kiloliter.
margins_costs.quote: The gross profit stood at INR388 crores compared with INR130 crores in Q2 FY '26 with a gross margin of 21%. The gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl compared with INR9,000 per kl in Q2 FY '26 and INR28,000 per kl in Q1 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss and related expenses of approximately INR21 crores presented as an exceptional item.
margins_costs.quote: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss of approximately INR21 crores. As this is a onetime event, we have presented it as an exceptional item.

margins_costs.claim: An ex gratia of INR15 crores to INR16 crores was paid across the board to employees during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: There is a INR15 crores -- INR16 crores ex gratia which has been paid across the board to everybody.

margins_costs.claim: Insurance rates and war risk premiums for vessels coming out of Hormuz have increased.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have not seen so much but only the war risk premium has been added from especially the vessels coming out of the Hormuz.

margins_costs.claim: Average selling realization grew to INR135,000 per kiloliter from close to INR80,000 per kiloliter at the end of last year.
margins_costs.quote: The average realization currently is INR135,000 per kl, which has grown from close to INR80,000 per kl at the end of last year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread was sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, which is 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue for the quarter increased by approximately 92% year-on-year to INR 1,732 crores.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, revenue for the quarter stood at INR1,732 crores compared with INR903 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR1,093 crores in Q4 '26, representing a growth of approximately 92% year-on-year and 58% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax stood at INR 206 crores, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR206 crores compared with INR26 crores in Q1 FY26 and INR37 crores in Q4 FY26, representing a growth of approximately 688% year-on-year and 456% quarter-on-quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spreads expanded to approximately INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared with approximately INR 8,274 per kilolitre under a normal operating environment.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin spreads expanded to approximately INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared with approximately INR 8,274 per kilolitre under a normal operating environment.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin for the quarter on a consol level was 21.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Plant capacity utilization across all 3 plants taken together is around 97% on a 2-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated borrowings reduced to about INR85 crores as on September 30, 2026, from INR168 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Consolidated borrowings which relate mainly to trade finance and borrowings at our overseas Texol level reduced to about INR85 crores as on 30th September '26 from INR168 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL reaffirmed the company's A+/Stable and A1 ratings and rated bank facilities were enhanced to ₹1,014 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: CRISIL reaffirmed A+/Stable and A1 ratings; rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of the shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: The stand-alone company, Gandhar Oil, is effectively debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a strong financial position on a stand-alone basis. We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to use about INR 20 crores of the quarter's performance for the payment of the interim dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, we have decided to use about INR20 crores of this for payment of interim dividend.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment remains challenging with ongoing tensions in West Asia and disruptions to global shipping routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during this quarter continues to remain challenging with ongoing tensions in the West Asia and disruptions to the global shipping routes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Key raw material base oil availability and prices remain uncertain, and freight and insurance costs continue to affect supply chain planning.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our key raw material base oil availability and prices remain uncertain and freight and insurance costs continue to affect supply chain planning.

risks_headwinds.claim: Silvassa unit 2 was affected by heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: As shared earlier, our Silvassa unit 2 was affected by a heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export volumes moderated during the quarter primarily due to geopolitical developments in West Asia and the impact on shipping and logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, export volume had moderated during this quarter, primarily due to the geopolitical developments in West Asia and the impact on the shipping and logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia impacted base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused disruption at the Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment was challenged by geopolitical tension in the Middle East, Strait of Hormuz concerns, and crude/base oil volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Texol operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and vessel movement disruptions arising from the geopolitical situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains focused on strengthening customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics in the PHPO segment.
management_commitments.quote: The PHPO continues to be our largest and the most important product category, and we remain focused on strengthening our customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics.

management_commitments.claim: Management will continue to focus on expanding the customer base, strengthening existing relationships, and improving the product mix in the lubricant business.
management_commitments.quote: We view this sequential improvement positively and we will continue to focus on expanding our customer base, strengthening existing relationships and improving our product mix to support our future growth.

management_commitments.claim: The company's focus remains on ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining reliable customer service, and minimizing external disruption impacts at Texol.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus remains on ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining reliable customer service and managing and minimizing the impact of external disruption.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on funding growth capex largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet, and creating sustainable long-term value.
management_commitments.quote: Our priorities remain focused on funding growth CapEx largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to emphasize disciplined working capital management, operational efficiency, and prudent capital allocation.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to emphasize disciplined working capital management, operational efficiency and prudent capital allocation while ensuring that our financial strength supports the company's long-term growth objectives.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding presence across geographies, and progressing capacity-expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of margins remaining at the current level or around this level for the whole year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of the margins remaining at this level or around this level. The current quarter looks good. And we are hopeful of it carrying forward at these levels for the whole year.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11% during this year.
management_commitments.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates margins would continue to be at stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

management_commitments.claim: Clarity on the strategy and specific plans for the South African arm will emerge in the next 1 or 2-odd quarters.
management_commitments.quote: There will be much more clarity being emerging in the next 1 or 2-odd quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
